title: Hooks Configuration Schema
description: Schema for configuring global hook settings in config/plugins.yaml

default_timeout.description: Default timeout for all hooks in seconds

enabled.description: Global enable/disable for all hooks (overrides individual settings)

HookOverride.description: Override configuration for a specific hook

timeout.description: Timeout for this hook in seconds

priority.description: Hook priority (lower numbers execute first, optional alternative to order)

before.description: List of hook names that this hook should execute before

after.description: List of hook names that this hook should execute after
